# Movin' In

> Movin' In is an open-source rental property management platform comprising an admin management panel, a web frontend, a cross-platform native mobile application (iOS & Android), and a Node.js REST API backend.

## Overview

Movin' In provides complete property rental workflows for single-agency and multi-agency operations. Agencies manage property listings, availability, and bookings through a dedicated admin portal. Customers search for properties based on location and rental dates, completing bookings via integrated payment gateways (Stripe and PayPal) or pay-later options.

- **Repository**: https://github.com/aelassas/movinin
- **License**: MIT License
- **Tech Stack**: Node.js, Express, React, TypeScript, React Native (Expo SDK 55), MongoDB, Docker

## Key Capabilities

- **Agency & Property Management**: Single and multi-agency modes, property fleet schedulers, flexible time-based availability, and automated email/push notification workflows.
- **Locations & Mapping**: Hierarchical location modeling (Countries, Cities, Locations) with geolocation coordinates and interactive map UI integration.
- **Payments & Checkout**: Stripe (Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link) and PayPal integrations. Supports Pay Online and Pay Later options.
- **Authentication & Security**: Social Sign-In (Google, Facebook, Apple) and traditional email/password credentials with role-based authorization (Admin, Agency, Customer). Protection against XSS, XST, CSRF, MITM, and DDoS attacks.
- **User Experience**: Multi-language support (English, French), multi-currency support, infinite scroll and classic pagination options, and mobile push notifications.
